content: If UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and a retransmission timer for a PN shutdown message (see ECUC_UdpNm_00098 ) expires, then UdpNm shall remove the pending request for a synchronized PNC shutdown of the correspond ing NM - channel from the storage and report the runtime error UDPNM_E_TRANSMISSION_OF_PN_SHUTDOWN_MESSAGE_FAILED to DET .
